objective: Author and independently challenge one additive SSI v13 contract repair without experiment execution.

candidates.title: SSI canonical v13 exact registry, digest, terminal, cost, replay, and scope repair
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the v12 static residuals can be closed by a byte-level successor contract without hiding source advice, semantic edge work, finite terminal behavior, accounting, controls, or baseline scope.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a review-supported v13 design contract and name the next separately authorized materialization step; this batch still executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record the exact unresolved contract obstruction and keep v13 unfreezable; no mathematical negative about SSI or ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining contract repair or falsification control; no experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Snapshot v13, obtain independent Validator and Red Team verdicts, then archive a narrow Coordinator disposition.

ambiguities.question: Does v13 contract completeness authorize execution or establish an SSI result?
ambiguities.resolution: No. V13 has maximum_runs zero, execution_authorized false, evidence_eligible false, and materialization/review gates.

candidates.dominated_by: Matched classical SSI/EndRing baselines remain the reference point; no Pareto improvement is measured or claimed.

sota_delta.note: Design repair only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable v13 snapshot plus independent review-adversarial verdicts bound to that snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves v13 at unverified design status and names one bounded next action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any registry mismatch, local preimage gap, shortened-frame gap, source identity gap, finite predicate gap, semantic equation gap, charge gap, replay gap, control gap, or baseline scope gap is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Any experiment run or backend diagnostic
Provider, edge, control, or incumbent materialization
Any hypothesis or research-question status change
Any breakthrough, lower-bound, security, exponent, or goal-completion claim
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent reviews and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Exact contract reconstruction and independent adversarial review; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by symbolic schema, digest, semantic, cost, and control review.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active candidate; snapshot and archive tasks run alone, with Validator and Red Team reviewing only the snapshot.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one snapshot, two independent verdicts, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on archive-integrity failure.

stages.stop_rule: Stop after declared producer artifacts or budget exhaustion.

stages.purpose: Snapshot and ledger-archive the bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact-path hashing, commits, and repository validation.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any integrity mismatch; otherwise after verified ledger archive.
